title: SAP Integration Discussion
summary: Acme Corp discussed integrating its SAP environment with the FUEGO data platform. The customer emphasized reliable data synchronization and asked for technical documentation.
decisions: FUEGO team will share integration documentation
commitments: Send SAP integration documentation to Acme Corp

title: SAP Integration Failure Review
summary: The initial SAP integration experienced connection timeouts. The team investigated network configuration and connection retry settings.

title: Integration Performance Review
summary: Acme reported slow synchronization and occasional dashboard delays. The team discussed batching records and optimizing the data pipeline.

title: Technical Follow-up
summary: The customer confirmed that the revised synchronization approach improved performance. Acme requested monitoring capabilities and a technical review meeting.
decisions: Continue with the revised synchronization approach
